questions.question: What does chapter 23 address?
options: Who may enter the assembly; community laws
How to keep the three great yearly festivals
How to prepare an army to go out to battle
How to choose and crown a king over Israel
questions.answer: Who may enter the assembly; community laws

questions.question: What did the law say about charging interest?
options: Do not charge interest to a fellow Israelite
Cancel every loan made within the city gates
Lend freely but always demand a pledge first
Charge interest only on loans of grain
questions.answer: Do not charge interest to a fellow Israelite

questions.question: They were to keep the camp holy because God walked in their midst.
